item.title: August 23, 2026 - Decision-making
item.description: Page 245. "Before we got clean, most of our actions were guided by impulse. Today, we are not locked into this type of thinking." Just for Today: I will use the principles of the Twelve Steps to make healthy decisions. I will ask my Higher Power for the strength to act on those decisions.
